choices.res: "Wait three weeks and count our carriages again," you snap back calmly. Isolde's smile goes hot and razor-sharp as her fingers catch your collar for half a beat. "Oh, I'll hold you to that date, upstart."

rivalEvents.text:
A Thorn footman knocks cleanly—followed half a breath later by Isolde herself leaning against your threshold, watching your modest evening traffic while her own salon runs packed two doors down.

"I have three restless merchants idling in my parlor waiting for suites that won't open for an hour," she purrs, violet eyes dancing with malicious amusement. "Take them off my hands if {house} wants the silver—or tell me you don't take charity from the Velvet Thorn."

choices.label: Take the silver and work them well (+300g, -desire)
choices.res: Coin is coin, and your doors need every gold piece right now. You welcome the three merchants smoothly while Isolde watches with one eyebrow arched high. "Practical. I respect practical—even when it's pathetic."

choices.label: Refuse and throw her own wine back (-100g, +house prestige & desire)
choices.res: You shut the ledger, toss her back the bottle, and tell her {house} builds its own regulars cleanly. Her eyes flash black with sudden fierce heat. "Stubborn bastard. Fine—earn it the hard way."
